scope: Focused narrative/scoping extension; 18 new works, not 18 independent lens-regression studies

records.title: Detecting gravitational lenses using machine learning: exploring interpretability and sensitivity to rare lensing configurations
records.dataset_and_design: Simulated multiband lens classification and compound-lens checks.
records.supported_finding: CNN interpretation using Deep Dream, Guided Grad-CAM and convolutional kernels has lensing precedent.
records.main_limitation: Classification and visual interpretation do not establish causal radius-regression reliance.
records.project_implication: Use as direct prior art; do not claim first lensing CNN explanation.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed
records.report_family_note: Preprint and publication treated as one work

records.title: An Unsupervised Hunt for Gravitational Lenses
records.dataset_and_design: Lens detection from simulated positives and survey images; augmentation and semi-supervised/GAN components.
records.supported_finding: Simulation artifacts can undermine lens classification; the proposed combined method improves detection.
records.main_limitation: Classification results do not identify Einstein-radius regression mechanisms.
records.project_implication: Include artifact controls and simple decorrelation before complex mitigation.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed
records.report_family_note: Preprint and publication treated as one work

records.title: LUMA: A CNN for Strong Gravitational Lens Searches in Astronomical Imaging
records.dataset_and_design: Physical-parameter tabular models predict whether a CNN lens classification is correct.
records.supported_finding: Physical configurations predict correctness; feature importance is examined across balanced realizations.
records.main_limitation: Associational correctness prediction is not an intervention on CNN inputs.
records.project_implication: Compare against metadata-only error prediction; require additional intervention evidence.
records.report_family_note: Preprint and publication treated as one work

records.title: LenNet: direct detection and localization of strong gravitational lenses in wide-field sky survey images
records.dataset_and_design: Wide-field lens object detection and internal feature-map illustrations.
records.supported_finding: Internal feature-map visualization is already used in lens detection.
records.main_limitation: Selected qualitative maps do not prove causal feature necessity.
records.project_implication: Feature maps may illustrate; they cannot carry the contribution.

records.title: Shortcut learning in deep neural networks
records.supported_finding: Benchmark success may use rules that fail under deployment shifts.
records.project_implication: Define shortcut by transfer failure under a specified shift.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed
records.report_family_note: Preprint and publication treated as one work

records.title: On the Foundations of Shortcut Learning
records.dataset_and_design: Controlled two-latent-feature classification framework and naturalistic tests.
records.supported_finding: Feature use depends on extractability as well as training predictivity.
records.main_limitation: Toy classification mechanisms need testing in physical regression.
records.project_implication: Vary cue correlation and arc visibility separately.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed
records.report_family_note: Preprint and publication treated as one work

records.title: The influence of correlated features on neural network attribution methods in geoscience
records.dataset_and_design: Synthetic correlated geospatial inputs with known attribution targets and repeated neural-network fits.
records.supported_finding: Correlation increases attribution variability; grouped superpixels reduce variability.
records.main_limitation: Accessible abstract assessed; detailed sample-size claims not verified here.
records.project_implication: Separate seed variability, grouping and explanation error from physical dependence.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed

records.title: Axiomatic Attribution for Deep Networks
records.supported_finding: Introduces Integrated Gradients with sensitivity and implementation-invariance motivations.
records.main_limitation: Attribution relative to a baseline is not a physical intervention.
records.project_implication: Use multiple declared baselines and numerical completeness checks.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed

records.title: Interpretability Beyond Feature Attribution: Quantitative Testing with Concept Activation Vectors (TCAV)
records.dataset_and_design: Concept directions and directional sensitivities in image classifiers.
records.supported_finding: CAVs relate model representations to user-defined concepts.
records.main_limitation: Probe separability and directional sensitivity do not prove causal reliance.
records.project_implication: If used for regression, validate continuous-output adaptation and concept confounding.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed

records.title: Sanity Checks for Saliency Maps
records.dataset_and_design: Model/data randomization tests of saliency methods.
records.supported_finding: Some saliency methods are insensitive to learned parameters or data.
records.main_limitation: Passing randomization is insufficient proof of physical faithfulness.
records.project_implication: Require sanity checks plus held-out rendered intervention tests.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed
records.report_family_note: Preprint and publication treated as one work

records.title: A Benchmark for Interpretability Methods in Deep Neural Networks
records.dataset_and_design: Feature-removal evaluation with retraining on image classification datasets.
records.supported_finding: ROAR evaluates importance through predictive consequences after retraining.
records.main_limitation: Removal and retraining answer a different question from fixed-model response.
records.project_implication: Keep necessity, recoverability after retraining and intervention response distinct.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed
records.report_family_note: Preprint and publication treated as one work

records.title: A Fresh Look at Sanity Checks for Saliency Maps
records.supported_finding: Randomization-test outcomes depend on noise and similarity metrics; modified tests are proposed.
records.project_implication: Predeclare comparison metrics; avoid one visual pass/fail sanity test.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed
records.report_family_note: arXiv flags overlap with 2401.06465; no separate study count

records.title: Shortcut to Nowhere: Demystifying Deep Spurious Regression
records.dataset_and_design: Continuous-target regression benchmarks; ColoredRotatedMNIST correlates background color and rotation angle.
records.supported_finding: Regression shortcut benchmarks and target/feature-based mitigation already exist.
records.main_limitation: Not lensing; attribute annotations and joint support matter.
records.project_implication: Regression alone is not novelty; add physical visibility controls and matched renderer interventions.
records.sections_assessed: Section 3 setup and Appendix C.1 synthetic regression construction
records.report_family_note: Preprint and publication treated as one work

records.title: Mitigating Shortcut Learning with Diffusion Counterfactuals and Diverse Ensembles
records.dataset_and_design: Diffusion-generated novel feature combinations diversify ensembles.
records.supported_finding: Counterfactual synthesis for shortcut mitigation has general-ML precedent.
records.main_limitation: Generated combinations are not guaranteed physically valid lens scenes.
records.project_implication: Prefer explicit physical rendering before learned image counterfactuals.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed
records.report_family_note: arXiv flags substantial text overlap with 2310.02230; not counted as an independent additional study

records.title: Do regularization methods for shortcut mitigation work as intended?
records.dataset_and_design: Theory and synthetic/real-data experiments on regularization.
records.supported_finding: Regularization can suppress useful features along with shortcuts.
records.project_implication: Test retained response to true signal changes as well as nuisance invariance.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed
records.report_family_note: Preprint and publication treated as one work

records.title: LenSiam: Self-Supervised Learning on Strong Gravitational Lens Images
records.publication_status: NeurIPS AI for Science workshop paper
records.dataset_and_design: SimSiam image pairs fix the lens model and vary source galaxies.
records.supported_finding: Physically defined lens-preserving augmentation has direct prior art.
records.main_limitation: Representation learning is not a radius-regression shortcut audit.
records.project_implication: Do not claim matched lens-model views as novel; distinguish source effects from nuisances.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed
records.report_family_note: Preprint and publication treated as one work

records.title: Lens-LeJEPA: Learning the Right Invariances for Strong Gravitational Lenses
records.dataset_and_design: Lensing-specific pretraining constraints; classification, axion regression and reconstruction.
records.supported_finding: Task-specific invariances can help classification while harming regression information.
records.main_limitation: Synthetic tasks; axion mass is not Einstein radius. Workshop page and PDF differ on headline accuracy gain.
records.project_implication: Audit which invariances preserve target information; do not copy headline gains without version resolution.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract, introduction, Appendix A invariances and Appendix H limitations

records.title: All Models are Wrong, but Many are Useful: Learning a Variable's Importance by Studying an Entire Class of Prediction Models Simultaneously
records.dataset_and_design: Variable-importance ranges over a specified set of well-performing models.
records.supported_finding: Equally predictive models can rely on different variables.
records.main_limitation: Permutation reliance is not the same as physically rendered intervention sensitivity.
records.project_implication: Study seed-dependent mechanisms among similarly accurate CNNs; do not call a seed range formal MCR.
records.sections_assessed: Abstract/landing or publisher summary; no complete full-text assessment claimed
records.report_family_note: Preprint and publication treated as one work
